features.title: Reject unprotected audit snapshots before agent spend
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/security-audit-snapshot.md. Actual permission bits must be checked after export before metadata publication. Preserve source bytes, budget refusal, owned cleanup, all prior tests and source-only limits. No target code or provider execution.
acceptance: Pass six frozen independent cases, including actual Linux and Windows-mounted mode observations.
Init refuses a snapshot that fails inspection before metadata/stage publication; exact export tree is checked.
No mode inspection result is represented as arbitrary same-user containment or tool isolation.

features.title: Reject static symlink ancestors in audit snapshot paths
features.description: Close the independently reviewed exported inspector path gap under spec/contracts/security-audit-root-path.md. Preserve SA-01 and all existing tests. No race, capture, target execution or provider work.
acceptance: Three reviewed static fixtures pass: ancestor symlink refusal, explicit dot component refusal, canonical trailing-separator control.
Inspect ancestors without following symlinks before subtree enumeration; preserve original init gating and diagnostic vocabulary.

features.title: Persist individual audit dispatch intent and returned results
features.description: Implement the journal contract only; actual private ownership, per-row durable transitions and conservative unknown replay. Keep existing audit metadata and upstream validators unchanged. No providers, crash-lock takeover, process-race or capture reproduction.
acceptance: Pass fourteen frozen ordinary journal cases and preserve all existing gates.
Persist dispatched state before callback and terminal result before returning; completed results replay without callback; uncertain calls stay held.
Finite per-record and aggregate bounds support more than 1 MiB combined payload; unsafe input/identity/path refuses without adoption.
Clearly retain lack of abnormal-process lock recovery until its later reviewed integration.

features.title: Preserve original workflow schemas through native JSON output
features.description: Implement only the pure shared native schema contract. Preserve all six graph schemas, vendored validators and existing hunt converter. No runtime, provider, filesystem or installer changes.
acceptance: Pass fifteen frozen pure schema cases.
Preserve optional omission, explicit null unions and open records without coercion or field loss.
Reject unsupported schemas and unsafe non-JSON values before executing hooks or Proxy traps; bound bytes, depth and diagnostics.
Fixed strict JSON-string wire envelope decodes once and validates the original schema.
